x86_execution_model: Win32 user-mode TSF surfaces in WOW64 applications on this AMD64 development machine; the shared core runtime and Broker remain native x64.
resume_condition: Explicitly review and approve any target beyond this machine's native x64 runtime and x64/x86 user-mode application hosts.
frozen_payload_policy: Retain legacy x86 and ARM64 base payloads unchanged for maintenance, rollback, and history. New active x86 artifacts must be source-built with the current local-product identity; ARM64 and other frozen targets must not be rebuilt, executed, or claimed compatible.
